question: What is the antonym of "Ineluctable"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Preventable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ineluctable"** refers to something that is inevitable or unavoidable, meaning that it cannot be escaped or prevented. (अपरिहार्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The ineluctable passage of time impacts everyone eventually.
 
 
• **"Preventable"** refers to something that can be stopped or avoided, indicating the opposite meaning of "Ineluctable." (रोकने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** Many diseases are preventable through vaccination and proper hygiene.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Ineluctable"** is **"Preventable"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Preventable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unavoidable** (अपरिहार्य): Something that cannot be avoided or escaped, similar to "Ineluctable."
 
 
• **Example:** Traffic congestion is often an unavoidable part of urban life.
 
 
 
• **Inevitable** (अनिवार्य): Something that is certain to happen and cannot be avoided, synonymous with "Ineluctable."
 
 
• **Example:** Change is inevitable as society progresses.
 
 
 
• **Inescapable** (अपरिहार्य): Something that cannot be escaped or avoided, also synonymous with "Ineluctable."
 
 
• **Example:** The consequences of his actions were inescapable.
